parameters.name: DeviceNameList
parameters.description:
The list of devices to which you want to re-authorize the license. Specify the **deviceName** of each device.

You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query the **DeviceName** of all devices under a specified product.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- For new Enterprise instances or Enterprise Edition instances, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- For legacy Enterprise instances that do not have IDs, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: LicenseCode
parameters.description: The license type. Currently, only Qianli Chuanyin is supported. Valid values: **LINK_SPEECH_COMMON_LICENSE**.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices belong.

You can view the information about all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.
